_readme: Local service providers indexed by the languages they work in. Powers /services. STANDING RULE: no row ships without a resolvable sourceUrl and an evidence tier. We publish what the source claims, not what we assume. A language claim is never presented as verified by us unless evidence is 'visited'.

_evidence.official: A government body, embassy or consulate publishes this provider on a list defined by working language. Strongest tier available without visiting.
_evidence.self-declared: The provider's own website states the language. Reliable about intent, unverified about fluency.
_evidence.directory: Only a third-party directory or aggregator states it. Weakest tier; these have a commercial interest in the listing. Many make a roster-level claim ("the clinics we list speak English") rather than one about the named business, and the row's note says which.
_evidence.visited: Someone from The Nomad HQ contacted or visited the provider and confirmed. Nothing carries this tier yet.

_format.city: City slug, must exist in cities-data.js
_format.name: Provider name as the source writes it
_format.languages: ISO 639-1 codes from _languages, as claimed by the source
_format.url: The provider's own site, if it has one
_format.sourceUrl: Where the language claim was read. Required.
_format.note: Optional qualifier shown on the card
